item.title: Whiskers 0.8.38
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.38

### General Settings

  • Added a new General settings page for everyday app preferences
  • Added controls for launching Whiskers at login and turning recording cue sounds on or off
  • Added update status and install controls so you can check for new versions without leaving settings

    • ### Improvements

  • Added update badges in Settings and the Dock so available updates are easier to spot
